plugins.name: smart-commit
plugins.description: AI-powered git workflow assistant. Generates conventional commit messages and runs pre-commit checks (lint, format, test).

plugins.name: plancraft
plugins.description: Plan-first development workflow. Research → Plan → Annotate → Implement with human-in-the-loop review gates. Never write code until the plan is approved.

plugins.name: pixijs
plugins.description: Build high-performance HTML5 games with PixiJS 8.x. Covers game architecture, scene management, input systems, collision, physics, tilemaps, audio, particles, and v8 ecosystem libraries.

plugins.name: pixijs-hud
plugins.description: Design responsive game HUD/UI for HTML5 games with PixiJS 8.x. Covers health bars, minimaps, inventories, touch joysticks, screen scaling, safe zones, and @pixi/ui/@pixi/layout patterns.

plugins.name: aiot-ai-agent-skills
plugins.description: Full bundle: smart-commit + plancraft + pixijs + pixijs-hud. AI-powered development workflow skills for Claude Code.
